annotation.title_clean: Whitepaper for the ITU/WHO Focus Group on Artificial Intelligence for Health
annotation.title_en: Whitepaper for the ITU/WHO Focus Group on Artificial Intelligence for Health
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Wiegand, T.; Lee, N.; Pujari, S.; Singh, M.; Xu, S.; Kuglitsch, M. et al. (ITU/WHO Focus Group on AI for Health)
annotation.venue: ITU/WHO Focus Group on AI for Health (WHO website)
annotation.summary_en: Whitepaper of the ITU/WHO Focus Group on AI for Health describing AI applications in health, challenges such as explainability and trust, and the group's work on standardized evaluation guidelines and benchmarking platform. Software-focused; no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: FG-AI4H develops guidelines for evaluating AI for health from regulatory, ethical and data perspectives
Proposes an online platform for benchmarking AI for health models
Standardized assessment is needed to build trust among developers, regulators and users
Topic groups and working groups structure the work, with benchmarking finalized via WHO consultation
Aims for effective, safe and equitable AI in support of universal health coverage
